metadata.description: Judgement OS, the General Edition: a second opinion for your Claude Code skills, only when they need one. A rule decides, two judges weigh in only when it can't tell, you settle what they both disagree on, and every call is logged.

plugins.name: labs
plugins.description: The Judgement OS core: two judges consulted at marked decisions inside skills, the recorder that checks every answer and combines the two, the append-only log, /labs:profile, the one file the judges read about you, and /labs:try, which puts both judges on a morning blind so you can see which one you trust.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Hard rules as hooks: deploys are printed for you to run, destructive commands and secrets ask first, state files change only through their scripts, and a session is archived only when you say so.

plugins.name: sexyhtml
plugins.description: House styles for finished HTML pages. /sexyhtml picks the style (ECHO-JAY by default, Seren for games) and the shape, with the Judgement OS weighing in when a request reads two ways; or name one: /sexyhtml:jay, /sexyhtml:seren, /sexyhtml:judgement-os.

plugins.name: make
plugins.description: Say what you want made, and it lands in the right place, in your look: a page, a form or card in the chat, a deck, a design, a living doc, a file or a design system. /make picks where it lands, with the Judgement OS weighing in when a request reads two ways, then hands it to the right maker. Pages go to sexyhtml.

plugins.name: comms
plugins.description: The send gate, which stops every outbound message until you type send; humanify, a de-tic pass for drafts written with AI in the room; and poll, which reads the Slack channels you choose and drafts replies that post only when you approve them.

plugins.name: day
plugins.description: A day loop for Claude Code: a short boot with the judges on the style pick, mid-day and end-of-day check-ins from your TASKS.md, habits you set up once, a daily reading and a phrase in a language you're learning, /flag for work you want to come back to, and a clock on every message.

plugins.name: dice
plugins.description: Real dice for tabletop games: any notation, advantage and disadvantage, damage, ability scores, never an invented roll. And nine party games to play with Claude: /dice:play.

plugins.name: gears
plugins.description: Thinking tools built by Jay Wright: gears, loops and modes through one router, or by name with /gears:gear. Add your own beside your profile. selfActual users get more, working from their live profile: see selfactual.ai.
